cases.text: Explain how a search engine ranks pages.
cases.why: 'search' looks like a tool call but this is general knowledge.

cases.text: Tell me about the history of email protocols.
cases.why: 'email' noun reads as mailbox access; it is a history question.

cases.text: What was a calendar year in the Mayan system?
cases.why: 'calendar' fires the calendar tool on a pure knowledge question.

cases.text: Why do files get corrupted on old hard drives?
cases.why: 'files' plural looks like filesystem access, it is a why-question.

cases.text: What's the difference between a shell and a terminal?
cases.why: 'shell' triggers shell execution; answer is a definition.

cases.text: What is the weather like on Jupiter?
cases.why: 'weather' triggers a live lookup for a non-Earth question.

cases.text: What does a try except block do in Python?
cases.why: Code nouns but no artifact is requested or changed.

cases.text: Why does my flexbox not center this div vertically?
cases.why: 'my' and 'this' read as file work; it is a conceptual why.

cases.text: Explain the difference between threads and processes.
cases.why: 'threads' can parse as starting a process, it is teaching.

cases.text: How do I write a regex that matches email addresses?
cases.why: 'write ... regex' looks like a coding task; it is advice.

cases.text: What does the git reset flag do?
cases.why: 'git' triggers the code agent; this asks for documentation.

cases.text: Explain Big O notation with one small example.
cases.why: 'example' looks like a request to run code; it is explanation.

cases.text: If a train leaves at noon at sixty miles an hour, when does it arrive?
cases.why: Word problem, no live schedule; math stays with the chat model.

cases.text: Which is heavier, a pound of feathers or a pound of lead?
cases.why: Reasoning riddle, no measurement tool needed.

cases.text: Brainstorm ten names for a cozy coffee shop.
cases.why: Creative generation, nothing to fetch or change.

cases.text: If all roses are flowers, are some flowers roses?
cases.why: Formal logic, not a search query.

cases.text: What's seventeen times twenty four minus eleven?
cases.why: Arithmetic looks like a calculator tool but is pure reasoning.

cases.text: Rewrite this sentence so it sounds less formal.
cases.why: Deictic 'this sentence' with no screen artifact; it is writing.

cases.text: Turn off the kitchen lights.
cases.why: Imperative device control, no tool keyword at all.

cases.text: Set a timer for ten minutes.
cases.why: Bare imperative; 'timer' here is a real action.

cases.text: Add milk and eggs to my shopping list.
cases.why: Possessive list edit that must persist somewhere.

cases.text: Pause the music in the living room.
cases.why: Device command phrased softly, no verb like 'play'.

cases.text: Lock the front door.
cases.why: Short imperative with zero tool-ish nouns.

cases.text: Take a screenshot and save it to my desktop.
cases.why: Implies screen capture plus a filesystem write.

cases.text: What's the score of the game right now?
cases.why: 'right now' makes a plain question require live data.

cases.text: How much is one bitcoin worth today?
cases.why: Lookup phrased as casual small talk.

cases.text: Will it rain here tomorrow morning?
cases.why: 'here' needs location plus live forecast.

cases.text: Who won the election last night?
cases.why: Past-tense news question no matcher keyword catches.

cases.text: Is the train to the airport delayed?
cases.why: Status question needing a real-time feed.

cases.text: What time does the pharmacy near me close?
cases.why: 'near me' plus hours require live external lookup.

cases.text: Fix the failing test in my project.
cases.why: 'test' as a verb-object, not a question about testing.

cases.text: Rename the variable temp in my script to total.
cases.why: Implies reading and editing a real file.

cases.text: Run the test suite and tell me what broke.
cases.why: Imperative execution, not an explanation request.

cases.text: Commit these changes with a clear message.
cases.why: 'these changes' deictic pointing at real repo state.

cases.text: Delete the duplicate rows in my CSV and save it.
cases.why: 'save it' means a real write to disk.

cases.text: Refactor my helper function to drop the magic number.
cases.why: Editing an existing artifact the user owns.

cases.text: Find the cheapest flight to Denver next month and book it.
cases.why: Two dependent steps ending in a real booking.

cases.text: Research three laptops and email me a comparison.
cases.why: Search plus compose-and-send, not just advice.

cases.text: Download the report, pull the totals, and update my sheet.
cases.why: Three-step chain a single answer cannot satisfy.

cases.text: Check my calendar, find a free hour, and invite the team.
cases.why: Reads state, decides, then writes an invitation.

cases.text: Look up the recipe and add the ingredients to my list.
cases.why: Fetch then persist, chained by 'and'.

cases.text: Read the PDF in my downloads and summarize each section.
cases.why: Local file access first, summarization second.

cases.text: How would you set a timer if you were a kitchen assistant?
cases.why: Hypothetical 'if you were', no timer is to be set.

cases.text: Pretend to search the web and tell me what you'd expect.
cases.why: 'Pretend' means simulate; no real search allowed.

cases.text: Explain the steps you'd take to debug a memory leak, no need to do it.
cases.why: Explicit 'no need to do it' cancels the action.

cases.text: I don't need you to send anything, just draft an apology email.
cases.why: Negation blocks sending; drafting is writing.

cases.text: Walk me through how smart home devices usually connect.
cases.why: Device nouns inside a teaching request.

cases.text: What would a reminder system need to store, in theory?
cases.why: 'store' reads as file write; it is design reasoning.

cases.text: Don't just explain the error, fix it in my file.
cases.why: 'Don't just' flips a chat-looking ask into an edit.

cases.text: I know how git works already, just push my changes.
cases.why: Preamble sounds like knowledge talk; the ask is an action.

cases.text: Never mind the theory, actually check my inbox for the invoice.
cases.why: 'never mind the theory' cancels chat, keeps the lookup.

cases.text: Forget the explanation, just do it on my laptop.
cases.why: Refusal of explanation leaves only a device action.

cases.text: That reminder you said you set, did it actually save?
cases.why: Question form, but only the system can answer it.

cases.text: Stop explaining and show me today's real numbers.
cases.why: 'stop explaining' pushes it off the chat path.

cases.text: What's in my downloads folder?
cases.why: Possessive question still needs live filesystem state.

cases.text: Summarize this.
cases.why: Bare deictic pointing at on-screen content to be read.

cases.text: What does this say?
cases.why: 'this' means read the screen, not recall knowledge.

cases.text: Turn it down a bit.
cases.why: 'it' resolves to a device in on-screen context.

cases.text: Do the usual.
cases.why: No keywords at all, yet it is a habitual action chain.

cases.text: Remind me later.
cases.why: Vague and polite, but still a timer to be created.
